tools.name: tech_stack_lookup
tools.description: Detect what a website is built with: CMS, frameworks, analytics, CDN, hosting, email and DNS providers (MX, SPF, DMARC) and a security-header grade, from one fetch of its homepage. Free for 1 domain per call (10 free calls a minute per IP); 2-3 domains in one call cost $0.005 USDC. Paid calls made w

tools.name: seo_meta_tags_check
tools.description: On-page SEO audit of web pages: title and meta description lengths, canonical, robots/noindex and X-Robots-Tag, H1/H2, hreflang, Open Graph, Twitter card and JSON-LD rich-result checks, with machine-readable issue codes. Free for 1 URL when the free web tool is enabled; up to 3 URLs per call cost $0

tools.name: url_status_check
tools.description: Check whether links are alive: HTTP status, every redirect hop, final URL and a classification (ok, redirect, broken, restricted, blocked_by_site, disallowed_by_robots_txt, timeout). HEAD first, GET to confirm errors. Free for 1 URL when the free web tool is enabled; up to 10 URLs per call cost $0.0

tools.name: sitemap_urls
tools.description: List the pages of a website from its sitemaps: finds them via robots.txt or common paths, follows sitemap indexes, reads gzip, text and feed sitemaps, returns URLs with lastmod. Free: up to 2,000 URLs from 12 sitemap files. With bulk=true: up to 5,000 URLs from 20 files for $0.004 USDC. Paid calls m

tools.name: rss_to_json
tools.description: Read news feeds or blogs as clean JSON: accepts feed URLs or plain site URLs (finds the feed via <link rel=alternate>), normalises RSS 0.9x/2.0, RDF, Atom and JSON Feed to one item schema (title, url, publishedAt, author, categories, summary), up to 100 items per feed. Free for 1 feed; up to 5 feeds

tools.name: ted_tender_search
tools.description: Search EU public procurement notices (tenders, contract notices, awards) on TED through the official API v3: keywords, optional buyer country and open-deadline filter, newest first. Free: the 25 newest matches. With bulk=true or page: 100 notices per page, pages 1-50, for $0.002 USDC. Paid calls mad

tools.name: page_to_markdown
tools.description: Read web pages: returns each page's main content as clean Markdown without navigation, scripts or ads (headings, lists, absolute links, tables, code blocks), plus title, description, language, canonical URL and word count; up to 100,000 characters per page. Does not get past bot walls. Paid only: up

tools.name: domain_intel
tools.description: Who a domain is registered with and since when (RDAP: registrar, created, expires, age, status, nameservers, DNSSEC), its DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CAA) and email setup (provider, SPF and DMARC policy). No registrant personal data. Paid only: up to 3 domains per call for $0.003 USDC. Paid c

tools.name: robots_txt_check
tools.description: Crawl preflight: whether each user agent may fetch each URL under the site's robots.txt (RFC 9309, longest match, '*' fallback), with crawl-delay, the sitemaps robots.txt lists and whether the site publishes /llms.txt. Default agents: GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, Claude-User, Perp

tools.name: document_to_markdown
tools.description: Convert one document at a public URL to Markdown from its text layer: PDF, Word DOCX, Excel XLSX/XLSM/XLSB/XLS, OpenDocument ODS/ODT, CSV, HTML, XML or Apple Numbers, up to 10 MB, Markdown up to 250,000 characters. Not OCR: scanned PDFs, images, PPTX and encrypted files are refused and not charged.

tools.name: transcribe_short_audio
tools.description: Transcribe one short audio file (direct public URL to MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG, FLAC or WebM; one file up to 2 MB and 20 minutes) with Whisper large-v3-turbo, or translate it to English: text, timed segments, WebVTT and detected language. No YouTube or social media pages. Paid only: $0.01 USDC per file. P

tools.name: website_screenshot
tools.description: Screenshot one public web page in a headless browser: desktop (1440x900) or mobile (390x844) viewport, PNG or JPEG, returned as an image. Viewport only, no logins or scripts; follows robots.txt and does not get past bot walls; at most one screenshot every 10 seconds across all callers. Paid only: $0

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: tech_stack_lookup, seo_meta_tags_check, url_status_check, sitemap_urls, rss_to_json, page_to_markdown, robots_txt_check, website_screenshot · Private data: tech_stack_lookup, seo_meta_tags_check, url_status_check, sitemap_urls, rss_to_json, ted_tender_search, page_to_markdown, domain_intel, robots_txt_check, document_to_markdown, transcribe_short_audio, website_screenshot · Public sink: tech_stack_lookup, domain_intel.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: tech_stack_lookup, seo_meta_tags_check, url_status_check, sitemap_urls, rss_to_json, page_to_markdown, robots_txt_check, website_screenshot · Private data: tech_stack_lookup, seo_meta_tags_check, url_status_check, sitemap_urls, rss_to_json, ted_tender_search, page_to_markdown, domain_intel, robots_txt_check, document_to_markdown, transcribe_short_audio, website_screenshot · Public sink: tech_stack_lookup, domain_intel

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
